note: Certificate authorities HARMONY refuses to trust, whatever Windows, Node or Chromium say. A certificate chain is rejected if any certificate in it has a subject or issuer that matches one of the patterns (case-insensitive). Add an entry when a CA is reported compromised; remove it only after the browser vendors have dealt with it.
